newsitem.title: GREECE: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS - APRIL 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS - APRIL 24.

text.p: Leading stories in the Greek general press:

--Foreign Minister Theodoros Pangalos yesterday ruled out any chance of face-to-face meetings between committees of Greek and Turkish experts. The 'dialogue' will be composed of letters to the Dutch presidency of the European Union. Meanwhile, the Greek and Turkish chief of staffs yesterday had a friendly meeting on the sidelines of the NATO.
--A 560 billion drachma Community programme for education - ignored for years and recently re-discovered - may not be available due to the intervention of the State Audit Council.
--A judicial inquiry into the whereabouts of 200 tonnes of toxic waste will begin in earnest next week. There have been charges that the toxic waste has disappeared.
--The European Commission wants superhuman efforts to see Greece achieve targets in the convergence programme.

--In a surprise move, Greece and the European Union have opened the way for Turkey's customs union with the EU and an eventual Greek-Turkish rapprochement. Athens said it would lift its reservations on financing Turkey if it accepted the latest EU document.

--The government has done an about-face on its plans for an expert committee to pave the way to better Greek-Turkish relations - it's now a 'non-committee' that will not have dialogue but will think about how to have dialogue through a third party - the Dutch EU presidency.
--Divers have brought up 111 objects from the wreck of the "Queen Olga", which sank off the island of Leros in 1943, after being hit by German plans.

--An Easter surprise for the Orthodox Patriarchate in Jerusalem as clerics discover a tunnel to the main church, dug from the neighbouring mosque. Clerics believe that Moslem fundamentalists are behind the tunnel.
--The General Confederation of Workers of Greece has responded with a resounding 'no' to 14 proposals put forward by the government for changes to the job market.
